text_block_list.text:
One day after training... Hishi Akebono 
came to the Trainer's Office.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Trainer-san. Do you have a 
second to chat~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Today is Valentine's Day, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So I have a super buono present for you, 
Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm all ready, so could you come along 
with me for a bit?

Following along for the time being... I 
arrived at a cafeteria filled with a sweet 
aroma.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ta-da~n!
Yes, where Hishi Akebono pointed to—

A gigantic chocolate cake sat enshrined 
before us.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking about how I could properly 
convey my gratitude to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"So, I figured expressing my feelings with 
an actual gift would be best after all—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I poured all my 'thank you' feelings into 
making it, and it ended up getting super 
huge~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, it's okay~! Being big is a 
good thing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Here, bon appétit☆

All in all, I decided to take a piece and 
try it for now, and――

It was an utterly mind-blowing, extremely 
delicious chocolate cake!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank goodness~. I made it just a 
little less sweet~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I was a little picky with the 
cake fillings too~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The top layer is biscuits. The second 
layer has nuts like walnuts and peanuts, 
and I packed the bottom layer with all 
kinds of fruit!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I want you to think it's delicious for as 
long as possible so you don't get tired of 
it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So, I'd be really happy if you ate until 
you're stuffed~

I thought it might be a bit too big, 
but... Still, it's a cake filled with such 
big feelings, so I want to finish every 
last bite.

I lost myself in eating the cake for a 
while, pondering the chocolate-filled life 
that was sure to continue for quite some 
time—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah. You can freeze it, so you don't have 
to eat it all at once~☆

At any rate, we were able to spend a 
memorable day together.

Chocolate was simmering inside the 
earthenware pot.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it's chocolate chanko nabe~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's called chanko nabe, the 
ingredients are fruit instead of veggies~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I thought simmering it for too long might 
ruin it, so I'll set it up right now!

And so, she carefully began arranging lots 
of decoratively cut fruit into the pot.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All done☆ There's plenty of seconds, okay? 
Come on, dig in!

Scooping up some of the fruit in front of 
me into a bowl and taking a bite—

It was a mind-blowingly, extraordinarily 
BUONO chocolate chanko nabe!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm so glad~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I thought about regular 
chocolates too. But then I thought that 
might not quite fit!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Since you're my special person, Trainer, I 
was thinking something even more special 
would be nice~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yup, that's right! But you see, this 
chanko nabe isn't actually finished yet.

The garnished hot pot looks cooked to 
utter perfection.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Chanko nabe tastes so much better 
when you eat it together with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Eating together makes it warm and cozy, 
and gives you the energy to try hard 
again~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So... hey, Trainer, would it be okay if I 
ate with you too~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yay, thanks~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Let's keep working hard together a 
whole bunch from now on too, Trainer!

Talking about the past and the future, 
they enjoyed the chocolate chanko nabe.
